headline: Classroom-lesson audit (936 entries), catalog rewrites (54 JP-faithful entries), UCC paperwork, Christine typo fix
summary: Major translation work: a full classroom-lesson terminology audit across 38 msg52 files (936 of 1,020 lesson entries updated against Freedom and Game 1 canon), a catalog-descriptions pass that reformatted 237 bug-book and fish-book entries to the catalog's actual 2-line / cap=48 display layout and rewrote 54 against the Japanese source, plus a beta-tester edit-suggestions pass, UCC variant-name paperwork, and a Christine typo fix.
